## Sensitivity to the forecasters' own input ranges

Size of the 2018 effect (log points) if the true impact followed other inputs, and that effect divided by the baseline's 2018 error SD at 3% and 5% a year. Ratios below about 2 mean the outcome could not separate that effect from baseline error. Scenarios marked 'project choice' use ranges the report does not cite.
